scripts.text:
[Aperture]
Hello there, adventurer.
I've been studying magic from all over Midgard to upgrade what I believe to be one of the greatest skills available to the acolyte class.
scripts.translation:
[光圈]
你好，冒险者。
我一直在研究米德加尔特各地的魔法，希望提升我认为最适合服事职业的强力技能之一。

scripts.text:
[Aperture]
I am the one and only Acolyte that has attained the Level 10 Warp Portal skill!
scripts.translation:
[光圈]
我是唯一一位把传送之阵练到10级的服事！

scripts.text:
[Aperture]
That's right! And...
I promise you that I don't forget locations that I have already memorized.
One day I will level up my skills to warp to wherever I please~
scripts.translation:
[光圈]
没错！而且......
我保证，已经记住的地点绝不会忘。
总有一天，我要把传送技能练到想去哪儿就去哪儿~

scripts.text:
[Aperture]
I am willing to warp you to the many locations that I have memorized for a small fee.
Would you like to use this service?
scripts.translation:
[光圈]
我可以收取少量费用，把你传送到我记住的许多地点。
要使用这项服务吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 要

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不要

scripts.text:
[Aperture]
Where would you like to go to?
I wish you goodluck on your journey.
scripts.translation:
[光圈]
你想去哪里？
祝你旅途顺利。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Aperture]
Come back when you need a warp.
scripts.translation:
[光圈]
需要传送时再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Aperture]
I'm sorry, but you don't have
enough zeny for the Teleport
Service. The fee to teleport
to {0} is {1} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[光圈]
抱歉，你的 Zeny 不足，无法使用传送服务。传送到{0}需要{1} Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Aperture]
Come back when you need a warp.
scripts.translation:
[光圈]
需要传送时再来找我。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
{0}
I'm sorry, but you don't have
enough zeny for the Teleport

to {1} is 1,800 zeny.
scripts.translation:
{0}
抱歉，你的 Zeny 不足，无法使用传送服务。传送到{1}需要1,800 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Primo d'Buffer]
Hello adventurer, you look like you are itching to get out there and save the world!
I can also tell that you haven't been blessed with '^6666ffVIP Status^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[普里莫·德·巴弗]
你好，冒险者！看起来你迫不及待想出去拯救世界了！
不过我看得出来，你还没有^6666ffVIP资格^000000。

scripts.text:
[Primo d'Buffer]
Hello adventurer, you look like you are itching to get out there and save the world!
I can also tell that you have been blessed with '^007FFFVIP Status^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[普里莫·德·巴弗]
你好，冒险者！看起来你迫不及待想出去拯救世界了！
而且你已经获得了^007FFFVIP资格^000000。

scripts.text:
[Primo d'Buffer]
My orders are to help out any Adventurer marked as VIP with special Buffs!
Currently I will give you ^ff0000+7 to all of your Stats for 30 minutes^000000 if you are VIP.
scripts.translation:
[普里莫·德·巴弗]
我的任务是为VIP冒险者提供特殊状态加成！
只要你是VIP，我现在就能让^ff0000所有属性提高7点，持续30分钟^000000。

scripts.text:
[Primo d'Buffer]
If you would like to be VIP, you can use WarpPortal to ^FF8C42Power-UP^000000 your game account with VIP Status. Of course there are many other advantages to being VIP, like higher EXP and Drop Rates, more Storage, and special buff NPCs like me!
Happy Journeys!
scripts.translation:
[普里莫·德·巴弗]
想成为VIP的话，可以通过WarpPortal为账号^FF8C42升级^000000并开通VIP资格。VIP还有许多其他福利，例如提高经验值与掉落率、增加仓库空间，还有我这样的特殊状态加成服务！
祝你旅途愉快！

scripts.text:
[Primo d'Buffer]
That is awesome!
Here is +7 to all your stats for 30 minutes to help you on your journey. Just come back when you need to refill your stats!
scripts.translation:
[普里莫·德·巴弗]
太棒了！
这份全属性+7、持续30分钟的状态加成能助你一臂之力。需要重新加成时，随时回来找我！

scripts.text: You must wait for the timer to finish before you can hire a new mercenary.
scripts.translation: 必须等计时结束后，才能雇用新的佣兵。

scripts.text:
[Clearchus]
Greetings young adventurer! I represent the Midgardian Mercenary Mission.
scripts.translation:
[克利尔库斯]
你好，年轻的冒险者！我代表米德加尔特佣兵团。

scripts.text:
[Clearchus]
We provide training to aspiring mercenaries by pairing them with adventurers such as yourself.
scripts.translation:
[克利尔库斯]
我们会让有志成为佣兵的人与像你这样的冒险者组队，借此训练他们。

scripts.text:
[Clearchus]
Our organization is 10,000 strong! Now let me see if you are registered for this service.
scripts.translation:
[克利尔库斯]
我们组织有一万名成员！让我看看你有没有登记使用这项服务。

scripts.text:
[Clearchus]
Unfortunately it appears that you are not VIP, please get VIP so that you can use this service. You can get a temporary VIP access by talking to Gramps at the Eden Group Headquarters.
scripts.translation:
[克利尔库斯]
很遗憾，你似乎不是VIP。请先开通VIP才能使用这项服务。你可以去乐园团总部找老爷爷，申请临时VIP资格。

scripts.text:
[Clearchus]
Vip is a very useful tool for adventurers to have, giving access to extra Kafra Services, discounted warps, exclusive content, and use of Primo d'Buffer. If an adventurer has full vip they even get an Exp, Drops, and storage boost!
scripts.translation:
[克利尔库斯]
VIP对冒险者很有帮助，能享受额外的卡普拉服务、优惠传送、专属内容，还能使用普里莫·德·巴弗的服务。完整VIP资格还能提高经验值和掉落率，并增加仓库容量！

scripts.text:
[Clearchus]
Your name is on the list.
scripts.translation:
[克利尔库斯]
名单上有你的名字。

scripts.text:
[Clearchus]
What kind of skill set are you looking for in a mercenary?
scripts.translation:
[克利尔库斯]
你想雇用哪种技能类型的佣兵？

scripts.text: Swordsman
scripts.translation: 剑士

scripts.text: Archer
scripts.translation: 弓箭手

scripts.text: Lancer
scripts.translation: 枪兵

scripts.text:
[Clearchus]
I have just the mercenary in mind!
scripts.translation:
[克利尔库斯]
我想到一位合适的佣兵了！

scripts.text:
[Clearchus]
Have fun now, ya hear?
scripts.translation:
[克利尔库斯]
祝你玩得开心，听见没？

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
Oh... I see from that look that you want me to work and give you Meat and Carrots...
Well my friend Izaac here has some Red Potions with him, but I only have some Carrots.
So I can trade you ^0000CC1 Carrot for 3 Jellopy^000000.
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
哦......看你的表情，是想让我干活，然后给你肉和胡萝卜吧......
我朋友伊扎克有红色药水，我这里只剩胡萝卜。
我可以用^0000CC1根胡萝卜^000000换3个杰勒比结晶。

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
If you're interested in my offer, get me the Jellopies I mentioned.
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
想接受的话，就把我说的杰勒比结晶拿来。

scripts.text: Carrots please.
scripts.translation: 给我胡萝卜

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
Alright, let's see what ya got...
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
好，让我看看你带了什么......

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
Hmm, look dude, I said 3 Jellopies for 1 Carrot... got it?
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
听着，我说的是3个杰勒比结晶换1根胡萝卜......明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
Not too bad...
How many do you want?
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
还不错......
你想换多少？

scripts.text: As many as I can get, please.
scripts.translation: 请把我能换的都给我

scripts.text: I want to choose.
scripts.translation: 我想自己选

scripts.text: Never mind, I like my Jellopy.
scripts.translation: 算了，我还是留着杰勒比结晶

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
How many do you want?
^ff0000You have enough for up to {0} Carrots.^000000
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
你想换多少？
^ff0000你最多可以换{0}根胡萝卜。^000000

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
Don't want to deal? Fair enough...
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
不想交易？也行......

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
Dude, I said for every 3 Jellopy I'll give you 1 Carrot.
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
我说过了，每3个杰勒比结晶换1根胡萝卜。

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
Don't bother me if you don't want to trade.
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
不想交易的话就别来烦我。

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
You are overweight.
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
你超重了。

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
There you go~! As I promised.
Try not to stuff yer face.
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
给你~说好了的。
别一口气全吃光啊。

scripts.text:
[Izaac]
Good day!
Have you collected any weird stuff from monsters?
I want things like Jellopy, Fluff, Shell, Feather of Birds, Tree Root, Worm Peelings, and Chrysalis.
I need those for something.
scripts.translation:
[伊扎克]
你好！
你有从魔物身上捡到什么奇怪的东西吗？
我想收杰勒比结晶、绒毛、贝壳、鸟羽、树根、虫皮和蛹。
我需要这些东西办点事。

scripts.text:
[Izaac]
Of course, I won't ask you to give me that stuff for free. What if I traded the following for ^CC00001 Red Potion^000000:
^00CC005 Shell^000000
^0000CC10 Fluff^000000
^00CC0010 Jellopy^000000
^0000CC6 Tree Root^000000
^00CC001 Worm Peeling^000000
^0000CC7 Feather of Birds^000000
^00CC006 Chrysalis^000000
Sure!
scripts.translation: 好啊！

scripts.translation: 这也太坑人了！

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Izaac]
So which items do
you want to bring me?

[伊扎克]
那么，你想带哪些物品给我？

how much {0}
you have on you.

[Izaac]
You have
a total of {0} {1}...

a total of {2} Red Potion(s).
scripts.translation:
[伊扎克]
你一共有{0}个{1}......
这些都给我的话，我可以给你{2}瓶红色药水。

scripts.text:
[Izaac]
What do you say?
Do we have a deal?
scripts.translation:
[伊扎克]
怎么样？
成交吗？

scripts.text: Deal.
scripts.translation: 成交

scripts.text: No deal.
scripts.translation: 不成交

scripts.text:
[Izaac]
Huh~
Alright.
Though are
{0} more useful
to an adventurer like you?
scripts.translation:
[伊扎克]
哈~
好吧。
不过，对你这样的冒险者来说，{0}不是更有用吗？

scripts.text:
[Izaac]
You are overweight.
scripts.translation:
[伊扎克]
你超重了。

scripts.text:
[Izaac]
There you go!
Check how many {0}
I've given you, it should be good.
Thanks, that was a good deal~
scripts.translation:
[伊扎克]
给你！
数数我给了你多少{0}，看看对不对。
谢谢，合作愉快~

scripts.text:
[Izaac]
A rip-off...?
If you check the market value
of the items being traded, I'm actually the one getting
ripped off here.
scripts.translation:
[伊扎克]
坑人......？
你去看看这些物品的市价就知道了，明明是我吃亏才对。

scripts.text:
[Izaac]
Alright, No problem.
But come back to me if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[伊扎克]
好吧，没问题。
改变主意的话再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Eve Natalia]
So I'm in town for a while to see if I can strike up some commerce with MVP hunters!
I'm willing to take some MVP gear and give you these upgrade Certificates I have in exchange;
if things go well enough I'll open up further business opportunities!
scripts.translation:
[伊芙·娜塔莉娅]
我会在城里待一阵子，看看能不能和MVP猎人做点生意！
我愿意收购一些MVP装备，用手头的强化证书交换；如果合作顺利，以后还会有更多交易机会！

So do you have any of the gears I'm looking for to get some random Safe to 7 Certificates?
scripts.translation:

I'm going to ask you which piece of gear you want to trade in, please verify that the 1st one in your inventory is one you want to give up.

scripts.translation:

我会问你想换哪件装备。请确认物品栏第一件就是你要交出的装备。

Hello there!  I'm Merry Badger and I was hired to exchange the ^00CC00Eden Merit Badges^000000!
